wild_elephant.name: Elephant
wild_elephant.fact_1: Elephants are the largest living land animals on Earth and have super long trunks!
wild_elephant.fact_2: An elephant uses its trunk to drink water, pick up food, and say hello.
wild_elephant.activity: Trunk Wave Game: Wave your arm like a trunk and make a gentle trumpet sound!

wild_lion.name: Lion
wild_lion.fact_1: Male lions have large, magnificent manes of hair that protect their necks.
wild_lion.fact_2: A lion's mighty roar can be heard from up to 8 kilometers away!
wild_lion.activity: King's Crown: Practice a proud lion pose and a gentle playful roar!

wild_tiger.name: Tiger
wild_tiger.fact_1: Every tiger has a completely unique pattern of black stripes, just like human fingerprints!
wild_tiger.fact_2: Tigers love water and are wonderful swimmers who enjoy cooling off in rivers.
wild_tiger.activity: Tiger Prowl: Walk quietly on tiptoes through imaginary tall grass like a calm tiger!

domestic_dog.name: Dog
domestic_dog.fact_1: Dogs communicate their feelings with their tails; a happy wag means joy!
domestic_dog.fact_2: A dog's sense of smell is up to 100,000 times stronger than a human's.
domestic_dog.activity: Fetch & Wag: Play fetch with a toy and give a friendly happy woof!

domestic_cat.name: Cat
domestic_cat.fact_1: Cats make a gentle vibrating sound called a purr when they feel safe and calm.
domestic_cat.fact_2: Cats use their flexible whiskers to feel the world and check narrow spaces.
domestic_cat.activity: Whisker Curl: Put fingers near cheeks like whiskers and practice a soothing purr!
